context: Saito explains a sensation-related symptom to a patient.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: medical explanation; vocabulary (感覚/現象/基礎/いれ/理論) in natural home.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 指の感覚が、少し鈍いんです。
lines.en: The sensation in my fingers is a bit dull.
lines.style: concerned office man voice, soft warm earnest delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: それは、よくある現象ですよ。
lines.style: calm doctor voice, soft warm reassuring measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 感覚は、戻るんでしょうか?
lines.style: worried office man voice, soft warm earnest delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 基礎的な運動を、続ければ戻ります。
lines.en: If you keep up basic exercises, it returns.
lines.style: clear doctor voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 力を入れすぎると、よくないですか?
lines.en: Is putting in too much force bad?
lines.style: curious office man voice, soft warm earnest delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 力を入れすぎず、ゆっくり動かして下さい。
lines.style: gentle doctor voice, soft warm caring clarity throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: この現象には、理論があるんですか?
lines.en: Is there a theory behind this phenomenon?
lines.style: thoughtful office man voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: ええ、基礎の医学で、説明できます。
lines.en: Yes, basic medicine can explain it.
lines.style: warm doctor voice, soft warm reassuring closing clarity throughout
